prompt: how to take the line of best fit with formula in Excel
response: To add a line of best fit in Excel, first plot your data as a scatter plot. Then, right-click on any data point and select "Add Trendline." Choose the type of trendline that best fits your data. To display the formula, check the box that says "Display Equation on chart." This will show the line of best fit along with its formula on the chart.
